rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxreso: Grants +20% spell stats to you and nearby allies for 60 seconds. Affects supported spells cast while active. Refreshes without stacking; cannot amplify itself.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxbrit: Marks a target for 15 seconds. The next direct damaging hit consumes the sigil and gains 10 base damage, matching that hit's damage type and element. Damage modifiers apply when the sigil is cast; defenses still apply. Healing, environmental damage and damage-over-time do not trigger it.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxarcl: Lightning strikes up to five distinct enemies. Starts at 10 base damage, losing 20% per jump. Jumps reach 6 blocks and require line of sight. A target can be struck only once per cast. Damage modifiers apply.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxburs: Grants +200% base movement speed and 50% more incoming damage for 15 base seconds, followed by 40% reduced movement for 10 seconds. Targets an ally, otherwise yourself. Cannot be recast during either phase. Speed amounts are fixed; duration modifiers affect only the boost.
rustboundmagic:item-spellcipher-rbxburst: Burst of Speed I Spell Cipher
rustboundmagic:item-toolspellscroll-rbxb: Burst of Speed I Spell Scroll
rustboundmagic:msg-world-startspelleffec: Burst of Speed I is active.
rustboundmagic:msg-world-stopspelleffect: Burst of Speed I has ended.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxbloo: On an ally, split incoming damage equally with the caster. On an enemy, echo damage suffered by the caster to the linked enemy. Lasts 30 base seconds. One oath per caster.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxbani: Banish a target for 8 base seconds: invisible, untargetable, immobile, unable to act or deal/receive damage. Returns at the same position without recreating the entity.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxunst: Deals 2 base nature damage each second for 12 base seconds. If the host dies, jumps to the nearest enemy within 8 blocks, refreshing its duration and adding 2 base damage per tick. No artificial transfer or damage cap.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxligh: A long piercing lightning beam deals 35 base damage to each enemy along its 60-block path. Solid terrain stops it. Each victim is hit once per cast.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxarma: Devastates a 45-block radius around you with 40 base fire damage and a 20-second burn for 3 base damage per second. You receive the burn, never the initial blast. Roughly 300 feet across.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxmana: Conjures an edible Mana Gem that restores half its conjuration mana cost (100 to conjure / 50 restored by default). The refund is fixed when conjured. Only one usable gem per conjurer, even if dropped, stored or transferred.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxlivi: Burns a target for 2 base damage per second, then explodes after 6 seconds for 25 base fire damage in 5 blocks. Nearby enemies also burn for 6 seconds; those secondary burns never explode. Early death triggers the primary blast.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxmark: Records your location on the unstackable Travel Mark held in your offhand. Carry any number of marks; the selected offhand item determines the destination.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxtele: Teleports you to the safe destination recorded on your offhand Travel Mark. The mark is not consumed.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxgate: Opens a one-way gate nearby for 30 base seconds. Players entering it travel to your offhand Travel Mark. The mark is not consumed.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxtwow: Opens linked two-way gates between here and your offhand Travel Mark for 30 base seconds. A shared transit cooldown prevents immediate bouncing back.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxconj: Conjures a fast flying cannonball for 25 base blunt damage. Impact splashes other enemies within 3 blocks for half damage. Requires no firearm.
Conjures a very fast bullet for 12 base piercing damage to the first enemy or obstacle hit. Requires no firearm.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxbliz: Hold your staff to rain large ice shards onto the ground where you aim. Enemies within 8 blocks take 3 base frost damage every half-second and move 40% slower. Releasing or moving stops the storm. Range: 32 blocks. Costs 20 mana plus 10 per second; lasts up to 12 seconds.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxstar: With a staff, hold to channel stars over a 24-block radius around you. Every 0.2 seconds, one random enemy takes 6 base arcane damage. Repeat hits are allowed. Costs 30 mana to begin and 15 per second. Maximum 15 seconds; releasing or moving ends the channel.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxsent: Summons a stationary 30-HP goober for 90 base seconds, firing rust bolts at nearby enemies every 1.5 seconds. One sentry per caster.
Summons a stationary 30-HP goober for 90 base seconds, firing fire bolts at nearby enemies every 1.5 seconds. One sentry per caster.
Summons a stationary 30-HP goober for 90 base seconds, firing water bolts at nearby enemies every 1.5 seconds. One sentry per caster.
Summons a stationary 30-HP goober for 90 base seconds, firing wind bolts at nearby enemies every 1.5 seconds. One sentry per caster.
Summons a stationary 30-HP goober for 90 base seconds, firing earth bolts at nearby enemies every 1.5 seconds. One sentry per caster.
Summons a stationary 30-HP goober for 90 base seconds, firing lightning bolts at nearby enemies every 1.5 seconds. One sentry per caster.
Summons a stationary 30-HP goober for 90 base seconds, firing frost bolts at nearby enemies every 1.5 seconds. One sentry per caster.
Summons a stationary 30-HP goober for 90 base seconds, firing nature bolts at nearby enemies every 1.5 seconds. One sentry per caster.
Summons a stationary 30-HP goober for 90 base seconds, firing arcane bolts at nearby enemies every 1.5 seconds. One sentry per caster.
Summons a stationary 30-HP goober for 90 base seconds. Throws blunt-damage rocks at nearby enemies every 1.5 seconds. One sentry per caster.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxseek: Fires a weak homing spark for 3 base arcane damage. Requires a visible enemy within 40 blocks; terrain blocks it.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxrico: Flings a pebble for 3 base blunt damage. Falls under gravity and ricochets up to three times off terrain, losing some speed with each bounce. Stops on its first enemy hit. Maximum travel 96 blocks or 10 seconds.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxdrys: Clears current wetness on an ally, otherwise yourself. Rain and immersion can make you wet again; this does not heat you or grant wetness immunity.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxretu: Sends out an orb that returns toward you, dealing 2 base arcane damage per enemy on each leg. Up to three distinct enemies, each once per leg. Terrain stops it.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxcind: Summons three orbiting wisps, each firing for 2 base fire damage at an enemy within 6 blocks. Launches are 0.75 seconds apart. Wisps expire after 15 seconds; recasting replaces the old set.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxconj: Fires eight 2-damage blunt pellets, up to 16 base point-blank damage. Severe falloff beyond 2 blocks. Hits at 8-9 blocks deal no damage and make a party-blower sound and confetti.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxstar: Staff channel: hold for 1-4 base seconds, then release a star for 2-8 base arcane damage. Costs 8 base mana per second of charge, 8-32 total. Interrupted charge mana is spent; scroll casting is not supported.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxpray: Places a charm on an ally or yourself. After a damaging hit, heals 3 base HP and jumps to another ally within 8 blocks. Five charges across the chain, at most once per second; expires after 30 base seconds without resetting on jumps.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxlife: Pulls an ally toward you, stopping at obstructions. A successful pull makes the recipient immune to all Lifegrips for 10 seconds. No caster cooldown; an immune target does not cost mana.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxmend: Places a 4-block-radius circle for 12 seconds. Each second, one total base HP is split among injured allies inside, including you. Full-health allies do not take a share. One active circle per caster.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxpart: Enemy: costs 100 base mana, prevents up to 15 total outgoing damage or lasts 4 seconds, whichever ends first; 20-second hostile cooldown. Ally/self: costs 10 base mana, adds cosmetic effects for 10 minutes without changing damage. More damage means livelier party-blower sounds and confetti.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxsnap: Casting stance: +80% cast speed, -20% spell damage, +10% mana cost at normal potency. Buff potency modestly improves benefits and reduces penalties, with capped scaling. Only one stance; recast to turn off instantly and freely.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxfurt: Casting stance: -25% mana cost and -25% cast speed at normal potency. Buff potency modestly improves savings and reduces the speed penalty, with capped scaling. Only one stance; recast to turn off instantly and freely.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxalli: Casting stance: +30% spell damage, -25% cast speed, +20% mana cost at normal potency. Buff potency modestly improves damage and reduces penalties, with capped scaling. Only one stance; recast to turn off instantly and freely.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxspit: Makes a large, loud magical explosion at your target or yourself. No damage, terrain destruction or knockback. Mischief Cipher research only.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxsque: The recipient squeaks like a rubber toy while walking for 60 seconds. Mischief Cipher research only.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxunso: An imaginary audience applauds when the recipient opens a container for 60 seconds. Mischief Cipher research only.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxconj: Drops a small illusory leaf onto the recipient's head occasionally for 60 seconds. Leaves cannot be collected. Mischief Cipher research only.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxsusp: Occasional suspicious quacking comes from behind the recipient for 60 seconds. Mischief Cipher research only.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxdram: Makes the recipient invisible for 10 seconds, then reveals them with lightning, thunder, smoke and a spotlight. Does not grant immunity or prevent actions. Mischief Cipher research only.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxhata: A stack of illusory wizard hats grows whenever the recipient casts a spell. Each new hat has its own brim and color. After eight growths the hats collapse into paper particles and start again. Lasts 120 seconds; no paper items are created. Mischief Cipher research only.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxpock: A tiny raincloud follows the recipient for 60 seconds and keeps them fully soaked. Wetness dries normally afterward. Mischief Cipher research only.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxheat: Select an item from your inventory to add 100 C of heat, shared across the entire stack and increased by potency. Stops below its melting point. Ordinary loose stones can be heated to 600 C. Canceling costs nothing. Throw loose stones at least 100 C hot normally: their native damage becomes fire, plus 1 damage per 100 C up to 600 C. Hotter stones make bigger harmless impact pops. Hot stones break on terrain impact.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxhoth: Safely handle heated metal and other hot items for 5 minutes, preventing their forced drop and contact burn. Casts on an ally player or yourself. Does not protect against other fire damage.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxbloo: Sacrifice 4 base health to restore 25 base mana. Health-cost reduction applies. Health costs can kill you. A shortfall of up to 0.5 health leaves 0.1 health.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxtran: Sacrifice 4 base health to heal a friendly player or owned creature for 8 base health. Requires an injured ally; cannot target yourself. Health costs can kill you. A shortfall of up to 0.5 health leaves 0.1 health.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxclot: Regenerate 0.2 base health per second for 30 base seconds. Taking health damage ends regeneration. Targets an ally, otherwise yourself.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxbloo: Sense wounded creatures as private red pulses for 60 base seconds. Maximum base reach is 64 blocks; bonus buff potency strongly increases reach: +50% gives 192 blocks and +100% gives 320, capped at 512. More severe wounds can be sensed farther away. Click the buff off to stop.

Sacrifice 3 base health to launch three staggered seeking blood missiles, each dealing 8 base piercing damage. Requires a visible enemy. Basic Hemomancy attunement required. Health costs can kill you. A shortfall of up to 0.5 health leaves 0.1 health.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxcrim: Sacrifice 4 base health to shield yourself or an ally against 10 base damage for 60 base seconds. Remaining shielding is lost on expiry. Basic Hemomancy attunement required. Health costs can kill you. A shortfall of up to 0.5 health leaves 0.1 health.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxredh: Mark an enemy for 20 base seconds. If it dies, divide 12 base healing among injured allies within 8 blocks. No items are dropped. Basic Hemomancy attunement required.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxopen: Curse an enemy for 12 base seconds. Moving deals 1 base injury damage per block travelled, limited to 2 blocks per second. Standing still avoids this damage. Basic Hemomancy attunement required.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxexsa: Hold a staff cast to drain 4 base health per second from a visible enemy, healing yourself for half the health actually removed. Costs 20 base mana to start and 8 base mana per second. Maximum channel 20 seconds. Advanced Hemomancy attunement required.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxhear: Sacrifice 35% of your current health before health-cost reduction. Each health point actually paid deals 1.5 base injury damage to enemies within 8 blocks and line of sight. Advanced Hemomancy attunement required.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxcrim: Invest 12 base health to conjure three blood goobers for 120 base seconds. They follow and attack nearby enemies for 4 base damage. Dismiss the caster buff to recall survivors: each refunds 75% of its actual invested health, scaled by its remaining health. Dead goobers refund nothing. Advanced Hemomancy attunement required. Health costs can kill you. A shortfall of up to 0.5 health leaves 0.1 health.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxbulw: Reduces incoming physical attack and injury damage by 1 per hit for 60 base seconds, after armor and Stoneskin. Targets an ally or yourself. Movement speed is reduced by 25%; potency softens the slow and modestly increases protection. At +100% bonus potency, protection caps at 1.33 per hit. Strong worn armor reduces Bulwark effectiveness, to a minimum of 40%. Only one rank can be active. Does not protect against elemental damage, poison, falls or health costs.

Reduces incoming physical attack and injury damage by 2 per hit for 180 base seconds, after armor and Stoneskin. Targets an ally or yourself. Movement speed is reduced by 25%; potency softens the slow and modestly increases protection. At +100% bonus potency, protection caps at 2.67 per hit. Strong worn armor reduces Bulwark effectiveness, to a minimum of 40%. Only one rank can be active. Does not protect against elemental damage, poison, falls or health costs.

Reduces incoming physical attack and injury damage by 3 per hit for 300 base seconds, after armor and Stoneskin. Targets an ally or yourself. Movement speed is reduced by 25%; potency softens the slow and modestly increases protection. At +100% bonus potency, protection caps at 4.00 per hit. Strong worn armor reduces Bulwark effectiveness, to a minimum of 40%. Only one rank can be active. Does not protect against elemental damage, poison, falls or health costs.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxholy: Conjures one Holy Hand Grenade. Right-click to pull its pin, release, then hold right-click to aim and release to throw. Bounces before settling, then explodes after an unpredictable 0-3 second delay. Movement restarts the wait. Deals 30 base physical damage at the center, falling off over 6 blocks, and can hurt its thrower. Does not damage terrain. Only one grenade per caster may exist, including stored, transferred and thrown grenades. Vanishes when its creator logs out. Requires a bound Conjuration core.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxwall: Wallops one enemy for 2 base blunt damage and launches it away. Spell power dramatically increases the launch, with a small fixed hop rather than increasing height. Hitting a wall shortly afterward deals another 4 base blunt damage. Damage modifiers apply. Requires no attunement core.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxcind: For 20 base seconds, walking leaves glowing embers behind you. Each patch lasts 6 seconds and deals 2 base fire damage per second to enemies standing on it. Overlapping patches do not multiply the damage. Never places fire or ignites anything. Requires no attunement core.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxbrea: For 30 base minutes, walking leaves a private trail of tiny, faintly glowing breads, with the occasional whole loaf. Each casting picks one bread variety for the entire trail. The whole trail remains until the spell ends. Click off the buff or cast again to clear it sooner. The bread cannot be picked up or eaten. Requires no attunement core.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxburs: Recovering from Burst of Speed. Movement reduced by 40%.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxrece: Cannot be pulled by Lifegrip again until this expires.
rustboundmagic:spell-description-rbxpart: Cannot cast hostile Party Foul yet. Cosmetic casts remain available.
itemdesc-travelmark: A dark recall stone with an ankh-like rune. The symbol is gold when blank and gains its destination color when marked. Hold in your offhand for Mark, Teleport and gate spells. Does not stack. Sneak-right-click to place up to four per block. Rename with /rune name <name>; /rune clearname resets the name (offhand first).
itemdesc-markbag: 20 backpack slots. Accepts Travel Marks only. Move the chosen mark into your offhand before casting.
itemdesc-managem: Hold and use for one second to restore half its conjuration mana cost (50 by default). One usable gem per conjurer; consuming it allows another to be conjured.
itemdesc-spellcipherempty-tier1-neutral-: A deliberately unserious blank cipher. Research it in a Spellforge to discover only mischief spells. Crafted from a tier-1 Neutral blank cipher and flint. Server admins can disable its crafting.
